If we have Σ (k=0 to n) 10^k = (10^(n+1) - 1)/9. Therefore, Σ (k=1 to n) 10^k = (10^(n+1) - 10)/9. 

Yes, so substituting n=321:

Σ (k=1 to 321) 10^k = (10^(322) - 10)/9.

Second part: Σ (from k=1 to 321) 1 = 321*1 = 321.

Therefore, N = (10^(322) - 10)/9 - 321.

So, N = (10^322 - 10)/9 - 321.
